caption: The drawing depicts a large, detailed bonnet in a sepia or light brown monochrome tone, occupying the upper left and center portions of the page. The bonnet is cylindrical in shape with a flared, rounded opening, and features horizontal, textured bands with wavy and straight patterns across its outer surface. Inside, a lightly shaded structure suggests the framework or support of the bonnet. A fabric piece drapes from the back of the bonnet, and wide, ribbon-like ties with scalloped edges extend downward, curling and folding on the page. To the right, two line drawings show simplified, frontal views of the same bonnet; the upper right drawing displays the bonnet with its tie ends hanging down, while the lower shows the tie ends arranged in a bow. The background of the drawing is plain and light-colored, adding no additional objects or patterns.
title: Bonnet
